legend.mapchallenge.populationNote: Only cells with density ≥100 are drawn (2,773 cells, about 5.2 km² each). Population is the GHSL 2020 model estimate, not household registration.
legend.mapchallenge.facilityNote: Only cells with density ≥100 are drawn (about 5.2 km² each); each facility type has its own color ramp and fixed class breaks.
legend.mapchallenge.overlapNote: Hotspot = top 10% of populated cells in Taiwan (about 5.2 km² each). Overlap = share of population hotspots that are also facility hotspots.
legend.mapchallenge.tcchNote: Hotspot = top 10% within each county (about 0.74 km² fine cells); the two counties are not compared with each other.
legend.mapchallenge.source: GHSL GHS-POP R2023A 2020 (CC BY 4.0), MOEA factory registry 2026-06, MOI temple registry, MOE school directory, MOHW medical facilities, cram school directory, OpenStreetMap (ODbL, convenience stores); taipei-gis-analytics Day 4 cluster analysis
